title: Related Questions

If there are other small pictures on the seat and other parts of the bicycles, will it be permissible with the intention being only the bicycles 3. If not, what is the ruling of the income received from it. Will it be halaal or just contaminated? 1498 views Q. Is it permissible to view animate pictures on Internet computer? 2442 views Q. I need a clarification based on Shariyat. My sister got married 3 years ago and still Allah not blessed her with child. After getting much pressure from her husband family, we had consulted with some of the best doctor?s in Chennai. Doctor?s said that, she can?t become conceive in a natural way as she doesn?t have the eggs of her own. The only way they have given us, TEST TUBE Baby using my sister?s husband spem with some other women?s egg. They will inject the both to my sister?s uterus. Referring the about situation, I would like to get clarification based on the Shariyat for the following questions, 1. Test Tube Baby method is allowed in Islam? 2. If it is allowed, then is it fine if we use other women?s egg for it? 3. If this also accepted, Is it acceptable if we get that egg from my another Sister ? 4. Now her husband is forcing her to go by Test Tube baby. Please let us know whether she can accept her husband wish or not if the Tube Baby method is not acceptable in Islam? 5. If the Test Tube method is not acceptable, please let us know on what basis it is not acceptable, as there was no technology like this in our prophet period ? 6892 views Q. I am a government employee. Last week I got annual prize in terms of money and certificate. Is it halal to use? And I have donated this money to masjid. Is it ok? 2475 views Q. I'm working for a global audit firm. Auditing is a statutory requirement. If it is haram or halal please provide me the reason. Jazakallah (Though some related fatwas were issued by you before it is not clear to me. There fore kindly reply. I can forward your reply to many of my friends working as auditors.) 3296 views Q. Regarding eating or chewing tobacco or gutkha 7124 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 45514 Country: India Title: about sin in shariath,how clear his sin Question: If one man (baligh) he touches to his sister's hand in emotional what is the sin? What is the ruling in Shariah? Answer ID: 45514 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 868/689/B=1434) He should repent this act. He should pledge firmly that he will not repeat the sin in future and then should keep on doing taubah and istighfar. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
